structuredContent.body:
## Why

The REI non-tilted LRS pilot needs independent matter and radiation initial anisotropic stresses. The earlier 81-case C21L run fixed the massive distribution at A=0 and therefore did not span those two axes independently.

## Changes

- Preserve REI PR147 source `3b85dedce84d37b3e165da00685a8a984950aafe` and the original full 40-state FP64 DOP853 problem, quadrature, and tolerances.
- Build signed full-Frobenius (S0, Pm0, Pr0) inputs by rebuilding the massive distribution and its normalization for every A, separately controlling common photon/neutrino quadrupole k.
- Complete 26 new z20-to-z4 trajectories and reuse one hash-bound C21L reference for a 27-point Cartesian preliminary pilot. Publish complete raw histories, per-case receipts, component tensors, CSV/NPZ, and PNG/PDF plots.
- Retain photon/neutrino decomposition, signed amplitudes, full/half norms, and cancellation. Initially opposing matter/radiation stresses cease to cancel and generate shear in this source family.
- Reuse immutable worker operators, exact moment expressions, single numerical-library threads, bounded adaptive dispatch, cooperative CPU leases, and create-only outputs.
- Inspect and deduplicate current external returns. Test the REC axis-response method retrospectively on the stored pilot without replacing exact trajectories.
- Prepare an optional 98-new-point NCP refinement grid and multi-run analysis, with CPU55 and coordinator costs included.

## Evidence

Six focused builder groups and independent physics review passed. All 26 new cases completed with four workers. The independent review checked 2,626 raw states, explicitly matched original-source fields and all 40 RHS components at 78 stored states byte-for-byte, and checked 672,256 reconstructed radiation angular-node values. Both primary PNG figures were visually reviewed. Full original trajectories were not rerun.

Initial-axis maximum absolute discrepancy: 1.7347e-18. Hamiltonian algebraic consistency: 2.2204e-16. Massive comoving-number discrepancy: 4.4409e-16. These are scoped diagnostics, not a global solution error certificate.

## Scope and publication

Preliminary collisionless **LRS** Bianchi I only. NCP execution and the optional 98-case refinement are NOT_RUN; general triaxial/full reionization/CMB extensions remain HOLD. No new performance benchmark or speedup/scaling claim; `global_error_bound=null`.

Stacked on the C21L component content `17244259d25f793a25e0874443a28806e7c31d17` in PR90. This content commit adds only `research/cr_c21m_independent_stress_20261021/`. Document-only closeout will bind actual provider receipts and executable handoffs.
